newsitem.title: USA: United Video CEO resigns, names interim.
newsitem.headline: United Video CEO resigns, names interim.

text.p: United Video Satellite Group, the parent company of Denver-based SSDS Inc, said Tuesday that Chief Executive Officer Ron Strich had resigned and that Jerry Parker had been named interim CEO.
In a release Tuesday, United Video said that Parker, who recently joined SSDS as chief operating officer, was a senior vice president of BDM Technologies until September 1996.
United Video is a partially owned subsidiary of Tele-Communications Inc.
